sources.entry: Cgit - Fast lightweight web interface for git repositories. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C

summary.name: cgit
summary.one_liner: cgit is a fast, lightweight web interface for Git repositories, written in C and run as a CGI program.
use_cases: host a browsable web view of git repositories
browse commit logs, diffs and trees in a browser
download tag or commit archives over the web
serve git repos with dumb HTTP cloning
summary.what_it_does: cgit is a web interface (CGI) for Git repositories, written in C. It provides basic repository browsing including logs, diffs and trees, and caches generated HTML. It supports cloneable URLs via the dumb HTTP transport, commit feeds in Atom format, and on-the-fly archives for tags and commits. It also offers side-by-side diffs, simple time and author statistics, repository discovery, GitWeb project-list support, and an extensive filtering framework using scripts or a built-in Lua interpreter.
notable: Written in C and runs as a CGI program
Built-in Lua interpreter for filtering, plus script-based filters and plugins such as syntax highlighting
Caches generated HTML and supports Atom commit feeds
caveats: Platform support is not stated on the page beyond a README with build instructions
